terra.problem: The line can imply that Peter wrote his letter in Bithynia. The passage says he addressed believers there, not where he wrote the letter.
“The Spirit says no” happened near Mysia, before Paul and his companions entered Bithynia; it did not happen in Bithynia.
“Peter writes to believers” concerns people in Bithynia, but the passage does not say Peter wrote the letter there.
